notes: family: area-majority. Built from the original 2015 March of the Ants rulebook; the Evolved Edition rulebook could not be obtained. One secondary source suggests the Evolved Edition end bonuses may be 2 VP (not 3) and that players who did not feed all ants in the last round are ineligible for them, and another mentions a 1-point penalty per unfed ant; these are unconfirmed. If 4+ players tie for a bonus, split-floor gives 0 whereas the rulebook gives 1 each. Full ant body = 3 VP each, battle win = 1 VP, hexes adjacent to the Great Tunnel = 1 VP each Slumber (all already on the track).
